summary_1line: Narada recounts Karna’s duel with Jarasandha and the curses leading to his death, while Yudhishthira mourns and condemns the war.

image_candidates.scene_text: Karna and Jarasandha, their weapons broken, grapple bare‑armed on the battlefield as Karna tries to tear apart the two halves of Jarasandha’s body.
Indra in disguise receives Karna’s radiant natural armor and earrings as Karna calmly gives them away.
Yudhishthira, weeping and trembling, raises his hand to curse that no woman shall ever keep a secret again while Kunti stands grief‑stricken nearby.
